# OpenFigura

> Local, agent-driven 3D asset production: image -> textured GLB ->
> neutral multi-view verification -> provenance-documented delivery.
> AGPL-3.0 code; generated assets belong to you. No cloud uploads, ever.

## Start here

- [Usage manual (agents & humans)](docs/usage.md): install, backend env
  vars, the six-step workflow, MCP registration for opencode/Codex/Claude,
  rules of engagement, troubleshooting.
- [Input quality contract](docs/input-quality.md): what makes a reference
  image usable; enforced by `openfigura preflight` / `figura_preflight`.
- [Input guide for humans](docs/input-guide.md): ready-to-paste prompts
  for commercial text-to-image models (GPT Image, Seedream/Doubao, Grok,
  Midjourney) that produce OpenFigura-friendly single-view references.
- [Design](docs/design.md): layering (LLM schedules, models generate,
  Blender processes), task workspace, provenance ledger, backend protocol.
- [Product brief](docs/product.md): positioning, falsifiable success
  criteria, business-model stance.
- [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md) and [Progress (verified facts only)](docs/PROGRESS.md).

## Key facts for agents

- MCP server `openfigura-mcp` exposes: figura_backends, figura_preflight,
  figura_new_task, figura_generate, figura_refine_texture, figura_rig, figura_render, figura_inspect,
  figura_export.
- Run `figura_preflight` before `figura_generate`; generation takes
  minutes to ~30 minutes depending on hardware; set timeouts accordingly.
- Pixal3D-generated models face +Y: render with facing=180 for front view.
- `visual_approval` in provenance ledgers is set by humans, never by agents.
- Backends are discovered via OPENFIGURA_PIXAL_RUNTIME /
  OPENFIGURA_PIXAL_MODELS / PATH; missing backends report unavailable.

## Licensing

- Code: AGPL-3.0-only (see LICENSE and LICENSES.md).
- Generated assets: not derivative works; yours.
- Name/logo: trademark policy in TRADEMARK.md; forks rename.

## Optional refinement and calibrated rigging

- [Source texture refinement](docs/texture-refinement.md): optional CPU detail extra,
  separate candidate and camera/ROI evidence; does not repair geometry.
- [Experimental calibrated Rigify](docs/calibrated-rigging.md): explicit bone data,
  no silent skinning fallback, no finger chains. Render selected pose frames.

## External algorithms

- [Neural rigging/motion](docs/neural-rigging.md): `figura_autorig` /
  `figura_retarget`; dedicated external runtimes, no manual coordinates/keys.
  MIA v1 CPU verified; current Xiaoman rejected, control passed.
- [3DGenStudio review](docs/2026-10-08-3dgenstudio-review.md): independent stack
  integrations planned; restricted Studio code not copied, GPU services untested.
